nodes.html: SMSF accounting is a regulated specialism. A specialist SMSF accountant knows the SIS Act compliance rules, contribution caps, pension phases, in-house asset limits and the LRBA borrowing rules. Matching to a genuine specialist means your fund stays compliant and your strategy is sound — not corrected years later at audit time.

nodes.html: Every SMSF must have an annual audit performed by an approved independent SMSF auditor, separate from the accountant who prepared the financials. The matched SMSF accountant coordinates this for you — preparing the financial statements and tax return, then engaging a qualified independent auditor to complete the compliance and financial audit.

A specialist SMSF accountant models the impact, advises on contribution timing, pension strategies and whether restructuring makes sense. This is forward planning that a generalist tax agent is unlikely to offer.

nodes.q: How do I find an SMSF accountant near me?
nodes.a: Enter your postcode and fund details in our 60-second questionnaire. We match you with a vetted SMSF specialist whose services fit your fund — setup, annual compliance, audit, or strategy. The matching is free with no obligation.
nodes.aText: Enter your postcode and fund details in our 60-second questionnaire. We match you with a vetted SMSF specialist whose services fit your fund — setup, annual compliance, audit, or strategy. The matching is free with no obligation.

nodes.q: Does my SMSF need an independent audit every year?
nodes.a: Yes. Under the SIS Act, every SMSF must have an annual audit by an approved independent SMSF auditor. The auditor must be separate from the accountant who prepared the financial statements. The matched SMSF accountant coordinates this for you.
nodes.aText: Yes. Under the SIS Act, every SMSF must have an annual audit by an approved independent SMSF auditor. The auditor must be separate from the accountant who prepared the financial statements. The matched SMSF accountant coordinates this for you.

nodes.q: How much does an SMSF accountant cost?
nodes.a: Annual SMSF accounting and audit typically ranges from $1,500 to $3,500 depending on complexity — more if the fund holds property, has borrowings (LRBA) or needs Division 296 modelling. The matched specialist gives you a clear quote after reviewing your fund. The matching itself is free.

nodes.q: Can an SMSF accountant help with Division 296?
nodes.a: Yes. From 1 July 2026, funds with member balances above $3 million face additional tax on earnings under Division 296. A specialist SMSF accountant models the impact and advises on contribution timing, pension strategies and restructuring options.
nodes.aText: Yes. From 1 July 2026, funds with member balances above $3 million face additional tax on earnings under Division 296. A specialist SMSF accountant models the impact and advises on contribution timing, pension strategies and restructuring options.

nodes.q: Can my SMSF accountant also handle my personal tax?
nodes.a: Often yes — many SMSF specialists also handle the personal tax of fund members. In the questionnaire, tell us if you want a firm that handles both your SMSF and personal return and we will match accordingly.

nodes.q: What if my SMSF is behind on its annual return?
nodes.a: Tell us in the questionnaire. Our network includes SMSF specialists experienced in bringing overdue fund returns and audits current — preparing the financial statements, coordinating the independent audit, and lodging outstanding years in sequence.
nodes.aText: Tell us in the questionnaire. Our network includes SMSF specialists experienced in bringing overdue fund returns and audits current — preparing the financial statements, coordinating the independent audit, and lodging outstanding years in sequence.

nodes.q: How quickly will a matched SMSF specialist contact me?
nodes.a: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched SMSF specialist will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your fund.
